result.summary: The page is largely well-designed, but one restaurant title in the 'Popular right now' section is truncated with a hard clip ('Tokumaru Rameı') rather than a clean ellipsis, which looks visually broken.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Tokumaru Rameı' is cut off mid-word at the right edge of its text container without an ellipsis, making the title look clipped/broken even though there is empty space to its right before the rating.
issues.suggestion: Allow the title to use the available horizontal space up to the rating block, or apply text-overflow: ellipsis with a max-width so truncation is intentional and clean.
